rules.finding: Unconditionally store version1.1.0 BEFORE Object.name/logging and any legacy field access. No local material/version guard. Retained ReadFontAssetDefinition calls this only for Unity inequality(material,null) and empty version. Failure after first store leaves version nonempty, so that later conditional upgrade can be skipped. Explicit calls have no local retry/idempotence guard; logging/name wrappers are unread.

Ordered direct FaceInfo writes: familyName=Name, styleName=String.Empty, pointSize=conv.i4(PointSize), scale=Scale, lineHeight=LineHeight, ascentLine=Ascender, capLine=CapHeight, meanLine=CenterLine, baseline=Baseline, descentLine=Descender, superscriptOffset=SuperscriptOffset, superscriptSize=SubSize, subscriptOffset=SubscriptOffset, subscriptSize=SubSize, underlineOffset=Underline, underlineThickness=UnderlineThickness, strikethroughOffset=strikethrough, strikethroughThickness=strikethroughThickness, tabWidth=TabWidth.19 setters are direct field stores (4 reused); no null legacy-info, finiteness, clamp or unit normalization guard. Float-to-int conversion is IL conv.i4; native/runtime edge results unexecuted. Other FaceInfo fields are not reset by this block.

If atlas-texture array is null or length0 allocate length1; otherwise preserve array identity/remaining slots. Unconditionally replace element0 with legacy atlas reference, without Unity/null/texture-copy check or resetting current atlas index. Convert legacy AtlasWidth/AtlasHeight/Padding with conv.i4 and store. Creation renderMode numeric0→4121,1→4117,2→4122,3→4118,6→16422,7→32806.4/5 and other values retain prior m_AtlasRenderMode. No texture creation, pixel decoding, atlas repacking or validation in this body; actual serialized state remains unverified.

Only legacy fontWeights null/nonzero-length is checked, then copy value-type pair slots4 and7 to current table in order. No source/destination>=8 or destination-null guard; slot4 may commit before slot7 fails. Fallback legacy list null/positive Count check, allocate target only if null with current source Count capacity; append EVERY source entry in ascending order without clearing/dedup/null-entry/cycle filtering. Count is reloaded at each loop condition. Derived under normal BCL semantics: a prepopulated target accumulates duplicates on explicit rerun; aliasing source/target makes the loop append to its own growing bound until failure or other intervention. Actual aliasing/termination is unverified. Shared target lists/arrays expose writes; no copy-on-write or registration operation.

Branch to assignment if sourceFontFileGUID reference is truthy; otherwise call String.op_Inequality(value,String.Empty), branch to warning ONLY if false. This is not a conventional nonempty check. With ordinary .NET null/empty semantics, null differs from empty and empty is a nonnull reference, so both route to assignment; this inference is not an executed BCL test. Preserve raw IL logic rather than claiming a working missing-GUID warning or resolved font reference.

Clear current glyph list, then character list, without null guards or new list allocation. Loop reloads legacy m_glyphInfoList.Count every condition; no null element/dedup/snapshot guard. New Glyph parameterless constructor initializes index0, metrics/rect via initobj, scale1, atlasIndex0, with only Object base ctor forwarded. Then direct setters assign index=UInt32(position+1), rect=(conv.i4(x),atlasHeight-conv.i4(y+height+0.5),conv.i4(width+0.5),conv.i4(height+0.5)), metrics=(width,height,xOffset,yOffset,xAdvance), scale=legacy scale, atlasIndex0. These are raw conv.i4/unchecked add/sub, not general nearest rounding or bounds validation. Append glyph BEFORE constructing TMP_Character(unchecked UInt32 legacy id,this,glyph), record id==32, then append character. Constructor retained, forwarded text-element base/unicode/glyphIndex/scale boundaries still open; textAsset/glyph setters remain phase106 evidence. Duplicate Unicode rows survive in list; retained definition rebuild later keeps first key. Negative IDs are not rejected. Failures can leave cleared tables, glyph-only or prefix entries; legacy tables are not cleared.

If no legacy id32 was visited, log and create Glyph(index0,metrics width/height/bearings0,horizontalAdvance=current ascentLine/5,rect=get_zero(),scale1,atlasIndex0), append glyph, construct/append character32. get_zero only copies retained static s_ZeroGlyphRect; implicit initializer/current coordinates remain unread. No clamp/finiteness/missing-face guard. Existing legacy space is retained unchanged, including duplicates. Then unconditional direct ReadFontAssetDefinition call. With unchanged version1.1.0 the nested definition skips legacy upgrade, rebuilds dictionaries, synthesizes, defaults metrics/padding, hashes and clears dirty; original outer definition then repeats its own post-upgrade processing. Current font state/material/global callbacks remain unexecuted; version mutation by reentrant external code is not guarded.

rules.evidence: all22 selected bodies; retained definition and synthesis hashes
rules.finding: Zero handlers/rollback/locks/registration calls in selected bodies. No direct material mutation in UpgradeFontAsset; retained definition reads material to derive padding and has unread feature upgrade/name/material wrappers. No inference of absent transitive registration/native effects. Shared fallback/weight/atlas references and new/old table aliases are unverified. First version write, face fields, atlas replacement, slot4 copy, fallback appends, sequential Clears, glyph-before-character Adds and nested-definition partial mutations survive later failure. Static proof does not establish runtime stability, source coverage, font rendering, editorial acceptance or delivery.
